name: Luca Esempio
headline: Frontend developer who turns designs into fast, accessible web pages
bio: I turn designs into fast, accessible web pages. I started out as a graphic designer and moved into code because I wanted my designs to work for everyone, including people who use a screen reader.
Today I look after the design system at Example Studio and teach colleagues how to write CSS that holds up.

projects.title: Colour Contrast Checker
projects.description: a small page that tells you whether two colours are readable together

projects.title: Focus Ring Gallery
projects.description: examples of keyboard focus styles you can copy

experience.summary: Built and maintain the studio's design system; brought the main product's pages to a Lighthouse accessibility score of 100.
Designed and built landing pages for small businesses.
